text:
ellis: FYI the nightly doc scanner flagged a couple of broken refs in the runtime examples (prefetch/batching area). low-effort but blocking a tiny customer test. anyone grab? :wave:
rina: can you paste the exact failing urls?
ellis: sure: `https://internal.redwood/runtime/prefetch#ttl-policy` and `https://assets.redwood/cdn/diagrams/prefetch-flow-old.png`
aj: first looks like a renamed heading, second smells like CDN rotation. I can rehost the diagram under /docs-images and add a 301. give me ~20m.
rina: i'll grep the repo for `#ttl-policy` and update snippets to `#prefetch-ttl`. happy to open a PR.
chris: please add a one-line changelog entry when you open the PR so we have traceability. also add the backlog card "DOCS-anchors-rot" for followup.
ellis: thanks. if you both take it, can you tag me in review? i want to sanity-check the staging anchor jumps and diagrams before merging.
docs-bot: link-scan: LS-2026-1501 created — issues=2 assigned=#docs severity=low
aj: uploaded `https://cdn.redwood/docs-images/prefetch-flow-v2.png` and configured redirect. left link in the PR comment.
rina: PR opened: `fix/docs/prefetch-anchors-309876` — replaces fragment, updates snippet, bumps alt text. requested review from ellis.
ellis: preview looks good; anchor jumps and image load on staging. tiny nit: rina, could you add a short comment in the doc reminding editors to run the link-checker after heading edits?
rina: added a short note and bumped the changelog: "docs: prefetch anchor rename + diagram rehost".
chris: added backlog card DOCS-anchors-rot and linked the PR. merging when CI passes. thanks team! :white_check_mark:
